items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: What did you play, Fess? Huh? What instrument did you play? Violin? I played the piano there.

ctx.x: And we had a bass player. And we had a bass player. Yeah, Eddie Dawson. Bracefella. Bracefella. Yeah, Bracefella. Bracefella. Bracefella. Yeah, Bracefella. He and his dad. And, uh, what was that when you got drunk? Is that the same place they called the entertainers later? The same building. I know. I know. I know.

What did you play, Fess? Huh? What instrument did you play? Violin? I played the piano there. Mm-hm. That's fine. That's fine. What did you play, Fess? What instrument did you play? Violin? I played the piano there.
That time. I went back there again and I played the violin.
